label: Architecture style
description: Architectural styles and regional building traditions, from classical temples to contemporary structures.
notes: Named architectural styles and visually distinct building traditions belong here, phrased before “architecture.” Building functions and structural types belong in place.building; room decoration belongs in interior_space.style. Period groups describe stylistic origins, while area groups describe associations rather than location restrictions. Brutalism and Brutalist are represented by a single Brutalist entry; broad families and substyles emphasize different visible features.
